features:
1. Main Tab (Core Gameplay Features)

   Auto Player: Hooks into Ro-Beats' underlying track modules to read upcoming notes in real time. It automatically triggers press and release inputs for your local slot, allowing you to hit full combos without manual input.

   Accuracy Selector: Adjusts the millisecond timing delay (noteTimeTarget) before inputs trigger. Choosing Perfect hits notes at peak timing (0ms delay), while Great or Okay introduces intentional timing offsets (-100ms) to simulate human error and avoid looking suspicious on leaderboards.

3. Troll Tab (Utilities & Visuals)

   ESP (Extra Sensory Perception): Applies a Roblox Highlight object to every other player's character model. Setting a red fill transparency and black outline lets you track player locations through solid map geometry.

   Noclip: Uses RunService.Stepped to constantly set CanCollide = false on every BasePart in your character. Because it fires right before physics calculations occur each frame, it overrides Roblox's default collisions so you can walk through walls and obstacles.

4. Feedback Tab (Community & Reporting)

   Message Input: A text field where you can write custom bug reports, error logs, or feature suggestions (requires at least 5 characters).

   Category Dropdown: Lets you classify your message under specific categories (Bug, Error, Suggestion, or Other) so the developers can easily sort incoming logs.

   Send Button: Uses HTTP POST requests (syn.request, http_request, or executor equivalents) to send your message directly to the developer's Discord channel via Webhook, automatically attaching your Roblox username and selected feedback category.

5. Updates Tab (Information & Versioning)

   Changelog Display: Renders static text labels showing the development history. It documents the script's evolution from legacy builds to version 2.0.X, including major milestones like migrating the UI framework from Wizard to Rayfield, fixing collisions, and adding feedback/kick safeguards.

5. System & Security Mechanics (Behind the Scenes)

   Place ID Verification: Instantly checks game.PlaceId against Ro-Beats (698448212). If executed in any other game, it automatically kicks your character to prevent script errors or bans.

   Upvalue & Memory Scanning: Scans loaded Lua modules in memory (getloadedmodules, getupvalues, getconstants) to locate Ro-Beats' private internal track system, hooking the note functions dynamically without modifying physical game files.

   Configuration Saving: Integrated into Rayfield to automatically store and reload your preferred settings (like Accuracy choices) between game sessions.
